For Coinbase, putting frontier AI to work starts with control over its data.

Every employee has access to the latest OpenAI models. In this video, Rob Witoff explains why security, guardrails, and zero data retention are central to that trust. As he puts it: “It’s still our data.”

OpenAI Private Intelligence gives businesses stronger controls over their data while using our most capable models. We’re building these protections with some of our largest customers to help businesses apply frontier AI to their most sensitive work.

Learn more about OpenAI Private Intelligence: https://openai.com/business/private-intelligence/

prioritas.indok: Vállalati adatvédelmi megoldás az OpenAI-tól, a Coinbase példáján keresztül bemutatva. Forrás-tapasztalat: -6.
prioritas.cim_hu: Saját adatvédelmi megoldással védi a vállalati adatokat az OpenAI
prioritas.lead_hu: A Coinbase is az OpenAI új vállalati funkcióját használja, amely garantálja az adatok megőrzésének hiányát és a szigorúbb adatvédelmi kontrollt a legújabb AI-modelleknél.
